title: Diagnosing Gurgling Drains and Vent Blockages
description: When a fixture gurgles or drains slowly despite a clear line, the issue often stems from poor atmospheric venting. Drain vents balance system pressure, allowing water to flow smoothly. A blocked roof vent or missing air admittance valve creates negative pressure, pulling water out of P-traps and letting sewer gases enter the building. Inspecting the vent termination for debris, bird nests, or ice dams is a critical first step in troubleshooting. Restoring proper airflow stops siphonage and returns normal drainage speed without unnecessary chemical treatments or redundant line snaking.
